notes: Modified cash basis governmental, accrual business-type. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); fund balances 998,107 -> 1,301,810 (p5); beginning cash not printed (null). ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents 736,773 and ending_investments = certificates of deposit 594,814 from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4); county treasurer cash 9,112 printed separately (not added). Transfer from other funds 100,000 (Sanitation Fund transfers to other funds 100,000, p7). Business-type from the proprietary statement p7 (net position); receipts = operating revenues 328,908 + interest 540; Sewer 'Other revenue' 5,437 counted in Charges for Services by the Statement of Activities (p2). Proprietary cash flows from p8 Total column. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), primary government only (Airport Authority component unit excluded); government-wide includes capital assets and debt, so not the funds balance sheet. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement pp13-14 (11 departments; supersedes the General Fund budget schedule p9, not recorded); Street and Lottery Funds from their budget schedules (pp10-11); nonmajor funds per fund from p12. Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule. Department functions follow the General Fund budget schedule p9: Administration = general government (TIF payments economic development), Cemetery = public works 15,249, Library/Pool/Park/Auditorium/Museum = environment and leisure 365,394, Fire/Fire Equipment/Ambulance/Police = public safety 530,577.
